title: Good Morning — Wake-Up Routine
body:
Set a gentle alarm or train your body to wake naturally. Adjust every time below to your own wake-up/work/meal/exercise/sleep schedule — the sequence and gaps between steps matter more than the exact clock time.

- 5:00 AM — Wake up gently. Eyes closed. Take 5 deep belly breaths lying down: inhale through the nose for 4 counts, hold 2, exhale through the mouth for 6.
- 5:02 AM — Slowly open your eyes. Look at natural light if possible (even dim morning light through a window) — this regulates your circadian rhythm and cortisol.
- 5:03 AM — Sit up slowly on the edge of your bed. Rub your palms together for 20 seconds until warm. Place them over your closed eyes for 20 seconds.
- 5:04 AM — Stand up slowly, feet flat on the floor. Close your eyes, feel your weight evenly on both feet. 3 deep breaths.
- 5:05 AM — Walk to the bathroom. Splash cold water on your face 3 times. Pat dry.

title: Morning Elimination, Tongue Cleaning & Oil Pulling
body:
Use the bathroom, empty bladder and bowels if possible.

Tongue Cleaning: use a stainless steel or copper tongue scraper, gently scrape back to front 7-10 times. Rinse mouth thoroughly.

Oil Pulling (Kavala/Gandusha): take 1 tablespoon organic sesame or coconut oil in your mouth. Swish gently for 10-15 minutes while continuing your routine. Do not swallow — spit out after 15 minutes and rinse with warm water.

title: Morning Hydration & Herbal Detox Water
body:
Drink 1 glass (250ml) of room-temperature water immediately — non-negotiable. Your body has fasted 8-10 hours; this kickstarts kidney function, flushes toxins, and preps digestion.

Herbal Detox Water — in a copper vessel or glass, mix and sip slowly over 10 minutes:
- 500ml room-temperature/lukewarm water
- Juice of 1/2 fresh lemon
- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder
- 1 pinch black pepper powder
- 1 pinch cinnamon powder
- 5-6 fresh tulsi (holy basil) leaves
- 1 small piece crushed fresh ginger

title: Pranayama & Breathwork (20 minutes)
body:
Sit in a quiet, ventilated room or outdoors, spine straight.

1. Dirgha Pranayama (Three-Part Breathing) — 5 min. Inhale in three parts (belly, mid-chest, upper chest), exhale in reverse order. ~8-10 seconds per full breath.
2. Anulom Vilom (Alternate Nostril Breathing) — 7 min. Inhale left nostril 4 counts, hold 2, exhale right nostril 6 counts; inhale right 4, hold 2, exhale left 6 — that's 1 round. Do 15 rounds.
3. Kapalbhati (Skull Shining Breath) — 5 min. Forceful exhale via belly contraction, passive inhale. 30 strokes, rest 30s, 50 strokes, rest 30s, 70 strokes, rest 1 min. Caution: if BP is above 160/100, have heart disease, or severe retinopathy, skip or do very gently under guidance.
4. Bhramari (Bee Breath) — 3 min. Close ears with thumbs, hum "mmmmmmm" on exhale, 7-10 rounds.

title: Early Morning Sun Exposure
body:
Step outside barefoot on grass/soil/concrete (earthing). Face the early sun (6:00-7:00 AM, minimal UV).

Sun-gazing: look at the sun for 10 seconds (eyes open, only in the first hour after sunrise), then close eyes and observe the afterimage for 20 seconds. Repeat 3 times.

Stand in sunlight for 15-20 minutes, exposing arms, legs and as much skin as safely possible.

title: Intensive Fasted Cardio & Movement — Choose ONE
body:
The most critical fat-burning, insulin-sensitising window — glycogen and insulin are both low after the overnight fast.

Option A — High-Intensity Outdoor Brisk Walk + Intervals (45 min): 5 min warm-up, then 7 cycles of 3 min brisk walk + 1 min fast walk/light jog + 1 min slow recovery, 5 min cool-down. Burns 250-350 cal.

Option B — Moderate Walk with Incline (40 min): steady 4-5 km/h with an incline, or 5 sets of stair climbing (2-3 floors) worked in. Burns 200-300 cal.

Option C — Indoor Walking/Marching (30-40 min): march in place with arm swings, overhead raises (20 reps/5 min), arm circles (15 each direction/5 min). Burns 150-250 cal.

Option D — Chair-Based/Seated Cardio (25-30 min, for severe joint pain/arthritis/extreme obesity): 5 rounds of seated marching (2 min), seated punches (1 min), seated leg extensions (20 reps/leg), seated torso twists (30 reps), seated arm raises (20 reps), rest 1 min. Burns 100-180 cal.

Option E — Swimming/Water Aerobics (30-40 min, if pool access): continuous swim at moderate pace, or chest-deep water walking if you can't swim. Burns 250-400 cal.

title: Post-Exercise Hydration & Recovery
body:
Drink 500ml (2 glasses) of water slowly over 10 minutes.

Herbal Recovery Drink: 300ml water + juice of 1/2 lemon + 1 pinch pink Himalayan/rock salt + 1/4 tsp raw organic honey (only if blood sugar is not severely elevated). Drink slowly.

title: Full Body Stretching & Flexibility (10 minutes)
body:
Hold each stretch 30 seconds/side, don't bounce, breathe deeply:
- Neck rolls: 5 each direction
- Shoulder rolls: 10 back, 10 forward
- Standing side bend (each side)
- Standing forward fold (30-60s)
- Standing quad stretch (each side)
- Standing calf stretch against a wall (each side)
- Hip circles: 10 each direction
- Spinal twist (each side, 20s)

title: Ayurvedic Self-Massage (Abhyanga) — Optional, Highly Recommended
body:
10-15 minutes, 3-4x/week. Oil by constitution: Vata (dry skin, anxiety, constipation, joint pain) — warm sesame oil. Pitta (inflammation, acidity, rashes, anger) — coconut or sunflower oil. Kapha (obesity, sluggishness, fatty liver) — mustard or sesame oil.

Warm the oil slightly. Apply with long strokes on limbs, circular motions on joints: head/scalp, face/ears, neck/shoulders, arms, chest/abdomen (clockwise), back, legs, feet (soles + each toe). Let it absorb 5-10 minutes, then a warm shower with minimal soap.

No time for full body? At minimum, massage feet with warm oil for 5 minutes every night before bed — this alone meaningfully improves sleep and reduces neuropathy pain.

title: Shower & Personal Hygiene
body: Warm shower (not too hot); if possible end with 30 seconds of cool (not cold) water to improve circulation and reduce inflammation. Pat dry, dress in comfortable loose clothes.

title: Work, Daily Activities & Hourly Movement Breaks
body:
Sitting is the new smoking — break up sitting every 45-60 minutes.

- 9:15 AM: work begins. Water. Screen at eye level, spine straight.
- 10:00 AM (5 min): stand, walk around, 10 standing squats, 10 shoulder rolls each way, 5 neck rotations each way, water.
- 11:00 AM (5 min): stand, walk, 10 standing knee raises, 10 calf raises, 10 torso twists, water.
- 12:00 PM (5 min): stand, walk, 10 wall push-ups, 10 standing side leg raises, overhead stretch + side leans, water.

Complete all three movement sets plus 20 minutes of seated/standing calf raises spread across the hour — mandatory, don't skip. Total water by 12:45 PM: ~4-5 glasses (1000-1250ml).

title: Pre-Lunch Herbal & Enzymatic Support
body:
Hingvastak Churna: 1/2 tsp in 1/4 cup warm water, 15 minutes before lunch — improves digestion, reduces bloating/gas, aids nutrient absorption.

UrCare BetaReViv (if prescribed, for neuropathy/nerve support or beta-cell regeneration): 1.5 tablespoons 35 minutes before lunch, with 1.5 tbsp desi ghee or 5-6 soaked almonds or 1 tbsp coconut oil. Should be prescribed based on clinical assessment, not everyone needs it.

Dining out: 1 bowl dal, 1 bowl mixed vegetable curry, 1 roti or 1/2 cup rice, and salad; avoid fried items, creamy gravies, naan, white rice, desserts; ask for less oil and salt.

title: Post-Lunch Movement (Most Critical for Blood Sugar Control) — Choose ONE
body:
This single window can cut the post-meal blood-sugar spike by 30-50%.

- Outdoor/indoor brisk walk, 20 minutes, moderate-brisk pace (recommended).
- Stair climbing, 15 minutes, 3-5 floors, steady, use the railing if needed.
- Household activity, 20 minutes, continuous movement (sweeping, mopping, gardening).
- Office-friendly: 15 minutes walking the building/stairs, or stand at your desk for 20 minutes.
- Seated/limited mobility: 10 minutes seated marching, 20 slow standing knee raises, 20 slow squats/chair squats, 10 minutes walking in place.

Or 20 minutes of seated/standing calf raises.

title: Evening Intensive Exercise & Strength Training (35-45 min) — Choose ONE
body:
The second most important window for metabolic health and weight loss.

Option A — HIIT + Strength (no severe joint pain/heart disease/mobility issues): 5 min warm-up; 4 rounds of a 6-move circuit (jumping jacks, squats, push-ups, high knees, lunges, plank — 40s work/20s rest, 60s between rounds); 8 min strength (squats, push-ups, calf raises, rows); 5 min cool-down. Burns 300-450 cal.

Option B — Moderate Cardio + Functional Strength: 5 min warm-up; 20 min brisk walk/cycling/swimming; 12 min functional strength (squats/chair squats, wall push-ups, standing leg raises, step-ups, plank on knees); 5 min cool-down. Burns 250-350 cal.

Option C — Yoga Asana + Strength Flow (40 min): joint warm-up, 12 rounds Surya Namaskar, then Tadasana, Vrikshasana, Trikonasana, Warrior I & II, Utkatasana, Paschimottanasana, Ardha Matsyendrasana, Bhujangasana, Dhanurasana, Setu Bandhasana, Halasana (skip if neck/back issues), Sarvangasana (skip if high BP/heart/neck issues), Balasana, then pranayama/meditation and Shavasana. ~200-300 cal.

Option D — Seated/Chair-Based Strength (30 min, severe obesity/arthritis/elderly): seated warm-up; 3 rounds of a seated circuit (marching, punches, leg extensions, torso twists, arm raises, side bends); standing exercises holding a chair (chair squats, calf raises, knee raises, hip abduction); seated cool-down stretch. Burns 120-200 cal.

Option E — Swimming/Water Aerobics (35-45 min, pool access, ideal for obesity/joint pain/back pain): warm-up water walk, 25-30 min swimming or water aerobics, cool-down. Burns 300-500 cal.

title: Post-Exercise Recovery, Hydration & Protein

title: Advanced Optional Exercise Plan B — Strength Training for Muscle Building & Metabolic Boost
body:
4 days/week (alternate days), 45-60 minutes.

Day 1 — Upper Body: push-ups 4x12-15, dumbbell rows 4x12, overhead press 4x10-12, bicep curls 3x15, tricep dips 3x12, plank 3x60s.

Day 2 — Lower Body: squats 4x15, lunges 4x12/leg, deadlifts (or Romanian deadlifts) 4x10, calf raises 4x20, glute bridges 3x15, wall sit 3x60s.
